# Systems

Registered systems (the names scenes use), render passes and the renderer / game objects that touch the registry. Conventions in [../README.md](../README.md).

## Registered systems

| Name | Scope | Source | Scenes | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [AgentFactory](AgentFactory.md) | World | [`humanbot.cpp`](../../../src/logic/agents/humanbot.cpp) | 5 | Makes the HumanBot walker of a world: loads its body and params files, builds the Jolt ragdoll, configures the world's AgentIO and starts the first episode. |
| [AnimalAgentView](AnimalAgentView.md) | Host | [`animal_view.cpp`](../../../src/view/animal_view.cpp) | 4 | Skins the library mesh of each world's physical animal on its ragdoll, follows one with the camera, can drive it with scripted orders, log it, lay a chequer. |

| [AnimalChecks](AnimalChecks.md) | World | [`animal_agent.cpp`](../../../src/logic/animals/animal_agent.cpp) | 2 | Checks a recording on the body: joint limits, lowest point, falls, stretch, foot slide, observation jumps, heading flips, speed against the command. |

| [model](pass-model.md) | Host | [`model_pass.cpp`](../../../src/renderer/passes/model_pass.cpp) |  | Draws the glTF models (Transform + ModelRenderable); gives their meshes to the rays. |
| [sky](pass-sky.md) | Host | [`sky_pass.cpp`](../../../src/renderer/passes/sky_pass.cpp) |  | The sky, sun, moon and stars: one fullscreen triangle, always the first pass. |
| [terrain](pass-terrain.md) | Host | [`terrain_pass.cpp`](../../../src/renderer/passes/terrain_pass.cpp) |  | Draws the marching cubes chunks: earth, soil patches, rock, relief, darkened under the grass. |
| [ui](pass-ui.md) | Host | [`ui_pass.cpp`](../../../src/renderer/passes/ui_pass.cpp) |  | Dear ImGui on the desktop window, an overlay drawn after the scene. |
| [vegetation](pass-vegetation.md) | Host | [`vegetation_pass.cpp`](../../../src/renderer/passes/vegetation_pass.cpp) |  | Draws the Plant entities with the SpeedTree library, levels of detail, far plants from their baked volumes; gives species to the rays. |

## Services

| Name | Scope | Source | Scenes | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Capture](service-Capture.md) | Host | [`capture.cpp`](../../../src/view/capture.cpp) |  | Runs a capture script (capture=<script.json>): scripted input, the camera of each shot, waits for the land to load, writes PNGs. |
| [ChunkLayers](service-ChunkLayers.md) | Host | [`chunk_layers.h`](../../../src/renderer/terrain/chunk_layers.h) |  | Allocates the layers of a 2D array image to chunk slots (soil maps, grass height maps): given when a chunk gets its mesh, retired NUM_FRAMES + 1 frames after it is gone or re-baked. |
| [ClassicRender](service-ClassicRender.md) | Host | [`classic_render.cpp`](../../../src/renderer/classic_render/classic_render.cpp) |  | The desktop render target: swapchain render pass, per-frame command buffer and ViewUBO from the Camera, recording of the passes (through SunVisibility with ray tracing), present, captures, gpu_times. |
| [Context](service-Context.md) | Host | [`context.cpp`](../../../src/renderer/context/context.cpp) |  | The Vulkan and OpenXR context (VRContext, Windu, Instance, Device, GpuProfile, Transfer, Compute, Swapchain) and the view set layout; puts Context* in the registry context. |
| [Game](service-Game.md) | Host | [`game.cpp`](../../../src/view/game.cpp) |  | The dynamical process: emplaces Settings, Executor, RunArgs, Graphics, FrameClock, Worlds; builds the renderer and the host SystemSet; runs the frame loop |
| [Lights](service-Lights.md) | Host | [`lights.cpp`](../../../src/renderer/lighting/lights.cpp) |  | Fills the lights uniform of the frame from the Sky and the nearest point lights. |
| [ModelManager](service-ModelManager.md) | Host | [`model_manager.cpp`](../../../src/renderer/model/model_manager.cpp) |  | Context variable that loads glTF files once (loadGLTF) or uploads meshes built in code, and hands out the entity holding their ModelC. |
| [PlantVolumes](service-PlantVolumes.md) | Host | [`plant_volumes.cpp`](../../../src/renderer/lighting/plant_volumes.cpp) |  | Bakes a density, colour and normal volume per plant species against the rays (ray tracing). |
| [Probe](service-Game.md) | Host | [`probe.cpp`](../../../src/scene/probe.cpp) |  | probe=<csv>: every probe_every frames the poses of the RigidBody (or Transform) entities, in entity order |
| [ProbeVolume](service-ProbeVolume.md) | Host | [`probe_volume.cpp`](../../../src/renderer/lighting/probe_volume.cpp) |  | The irradiance probes on the GPU: bricks per lit chunk, a ray budget a frame (ray tracing). |
| [RayScene](service-RayScene.md) | Host | [`ray_scene.cpp`](../../../src/renderer/lighting/ray_scene.cpp) |  | Acceleration structures of chunks, meshes, animals and the top level every frame, with the geometry table (ray tracing). |
| [Renderer](service-Renderer.md) | Host | [`renderer.cpp`](../../../src/renderer/renderer.cpp) |  | Owns the Vulkan context, the desktop and headset targets, the shared lighting / shade / soil state and the scene passes; runs the frame (prepare, updates, transfer -> compute -> graphics, parallel recording, present). |

| [SunVisibility](service-SunVisibility.md) | Host | [`sun_visibility.cpp`](../../../src/renderer/lighting/sun_visibility.cpp) |  | Per target scene render pass with the sun apart, the traced and filtered sun visibility, the composite (ray tracing). |
